remarks: Beautiful 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit in desirable Stamford location is ready for a new tenant. This bright and air unit, located in a complex with amenities such as an in-ground pool and playground, boats an open concept kitchen and living situation, allowing conversations to flow freely with guests or family. In the large bedroom of this end unit, you will find the privacy and relaxation you crave after a long day. Sit on the porch overlooking beautiful trees with a morning cup of coffee while listening to the birds. A beautiful lobby greets guests upon arrival. Steps to schools, Tully Health Center, and parks. Minutes to shopping, dining, entertainment, transportation, and more. The unit can be leased furnished as-is or semi-furnished. A must-see!
